definitions.explanation: A problem or imperfection in something that prevents it from working properly.

examples.japanese: ⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{欠陥|けっかん}
{欠陥|けっかん}⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧
⟦{設計|せっけい}→設計：03300_sekkei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{欠陥|けっかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a flaw in the design.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{重大|じゅうだい}→重大：01641_juudai⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧{欠陥|けっかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかり→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧、⟦メーカー→メーカー：11158_meekaa⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{全国|ぜんこく}→全国：03311_zenkoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦リコール→リコール：29697_rikooru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{実施|じっし}→実施：03275_jisshi⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A serious defect was found in this car, and the manufacturer implemented a nationwide recall.

examples.japanese: {欠陥|けっかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{交換|こうかん}→交換：02746_koukan⟧⟦いたします→いたす：01314_itasu⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦ご→ご：09882_go⟧⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: If a defect is found, we will replace it immediately, so please contact us.

notes:
{欠陥|けっかん} refers to a serious defect or flaw, typically in products, systems, or designs. It implies a fundamental problem, not just a minor imperfection.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {欠陥|けっかん}⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧: defective product
- {欠陥|けっかん}⟦{住宅|じゅうたく}→住宅：03280_juutaku⟧: defective housing
- {欠陥|けっかん}⟦{車|しゃ}→車：09874_sha⟧: defective vehicle
- {欠陥|けっかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to discover a defect
- {欠陥|けっかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{修正|しゅうせい}→修正：03210_shuusei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to fix a defect

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{欠点|けってん}→欠点：02702_ketten⟧: shortcoming, weak point (often for people or abstract things)
- ⟦{不良|ふりょう}→不良：11320_furyou⟧: defective (quality control; ⟦{不良品|ふりょうひん}→不良品：19452_furyouhin⟧ = defective item)
- ⟦{傷|きず}→傷：02201_kizu⟧: flaw, scratch (physical damage)

USAGE:
Common in consumer protection, manufacturing, and news contexts. {欠陥|けっかん} carries a stronger tone than ⟦{欠点|けってん}→欠点：02702_ketten⟧ — it suggests something that should not have passed inspection.

cross_references.label: shortcoming or weakness (people/abstract); less severe than 欠陥
